name: auto-antigravity
description: Auto Accept + Ralph Loop for Antigravity — auto-click agent buttons and run iterative AI loops with persistent memory.

autoAntigravity.autoAccept.pollInterval.description: Auto Accept polling interval in milliseconds

autoAntigravity.autoAccept.customButtonT.description: Extra button texts to auto-click (for i18n or custom UI)

autoAntigravity.autoAccept.cdpPort.description: CDP remote-debugging-port (default 9559 avoids browser control conflict)

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.maxIterations.description: Maximum Ralph Loop iterations before auto-stop

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.taskFile.description: Task file name (relative to workspace root)

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.progressFile.description: Progress file name (relative to workspace root)

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.autoCommit.description: Automatically git commit after each iteration

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.autoDeleteBran.description: Automatically delete task branch after merge (자동 브랜치 폐기)

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.autoPush.description: 세션 종료 후 자동으로 git push 실행 (Auto push after session ends)

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.allowPrdModifi.description: Allow agent to add/modify tasks in PRD file during Ralph Loop iterations

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.autoStart.description: PRD 파일 변경 감지 시 Ralph Loop 자동 시작 (Auto-start Ralph Loop when task file changes)

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.enableParallel.description: [병렬진행] 태그가 있는 작업을 병렬로 실행 (Enable parallel execution for tasks tagged with [병렬진행])

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.maxParallelTas.description: 동시 실행 가능한 최대 병렬 작업 수 (Maximum concurrent parallel tasks)

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.sparseCheckout.description: 병렬 워크트리 sparse-checkout 경로 목록 — 프로젝트별로 설정 필요. 비어있으면 전체 체크아웃. Unity 프로젝트(Assets/ + ProjectSettings/ 존재)는 Assets/Script, Assets/Scripts, ProjectSettings 경로가 자동 포함됩니다.

autoAntigravity.updater.autoInstall.description: 새 버전 감지 시 확인 없이 자동 설치 (Auto-install updates without confirmation)

autoAntigravity.telemetry.pollInterval.description: AI 모델 사용량 조회 간격 (초) — Telemetry polling interval in seconds

autoAntigravity.telegram.enabled.description: 텔레그램 봇 연동 활성화 — 워크스페이스 루트의 .env 파일에 TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN과 TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID를 설정하세요. (Enable Telegram bot. Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in the workspace .env file.)

autoAntigravity.ralphLoop.enableCodeRevi.description: 작업 완료 후 Gemini Flash 모델로 변경된 코드를 리뷰합니다. (Enable code review by Gemini Flash after task completion)

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin master --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin master --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin master --tags
